description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It sets up a single-activity architecture with a bottom navigation bar for navigating between different sections such as Home, Search, and Favorites. The class overrides the onCreate method to initialize the view, set up the layout, and connect the BottomNavigationView with the NavController to handle navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An AppCompatActivity subclass serving as the main host activity for the app, managing navigation and the bottom navigation UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; sets up user interface and navigation components.
